BasisDto.description: PRF-ANA-06: provenance basis for a build_graph result.

complete.description: `true` only when every identity component was established.

config_digest.description:
Digest over the effective configuration relevant to the build.
Stable across identical configurations; changes when config changes.

source_manifest_digest.description:
Digest over the source manifest (sorted relative paths + content
hashes). Same sources ⇒ same digest; any source change ⇒ different
digest. Empty when the manifest could not be computed.

workspace.description: Canonicalized workspace path the graph was built from.

EdgeInfo.description: A single edge in the build_graph response.

SkippedFileDto.description: F2.W8: per-file skipped-file record surfaced through `build_graph`.

basis.description:
PRF-ANA-06: identity of what the graph was built from.
`None` only when identity cannot be established at all;
otherwise present with `complete: false` when any component
(workspace canonicalization, manifest digest) is unavailable.

skipped_files.description:
F2.W8: files that could not be processed during the walk.
`None` when the graph was served from cache (no walk happened
on this call); `Some([])` when the walk finished with no
omissions; `Some([..])` when one or more files were dropped
because of I/O / parsing failures.

status.description:
PRF-ANA-04: explicit build outcome surfaced to the caller so
consumers (LLM, CI, alert) can branch on it without parsing
`skipped_files`. Values:
  - `"complete"`: walk happened, no skipped files.
  - `"partial"`: walk happened, at least one file was
    dropped (I/O or parsing failure).
  - `"unknown"`: served from the in-memory graph cache, no
    walk happened on this call.
